basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex, a tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I've recently got into DIY electronics, particularly with LED lighting projects. In my free time, I love exploring new games, especially indie ones. I'm currently working as a junior software tester at a startup. I'm single and usually online during the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm new to the world of DIY electronics and LED programming. I've been learning through online tutorials and forums, exploring both FastLED and WLED. My background in software testing helps me understand the basics of coding, but I'm still a novice with hands-on hardware projects.
